basic_profile.bio: I'm a 39-year-old digital enthusiast living in Providence, Rhode Island. I've always been fascinated by the intersection of technology and storytelling, which is why Digimon captured my imagination from an early age. By day, I work as a retail manager, a job that keeps me busy but also allows me to interact with a variety of people. In my downtime, I enjoy playing video games, particularly those with a rich narrative like the Digimon series. I’m a fan of live music and often play my Schecter guitar to unwind. My partner and I are exploring polyamory, which has led me to seek out communities for support and discussion. I typically browse Reddit in the evenings, after work, and sometimes during lunch breaks.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: Having grown up in the late 90s, I developed a deep love for digital monsters through both the anime and games. My expertise lies primarily in the Digimon franchise, developed through years of watching the series and playing various games. Additionally, my job in retail has honed my skills in customer service and management, while my personal interest in music has led me to self-teach guitar.
